chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī:
Indeed, Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام ruled that for the hāshimah, the compensation is ten camels.

key_terms.الْهَاشِمَةِ: A wound that breaks or fractures the bone
key_terms.بِعَشْرٍ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ: Compensation of ten camels as blood money
key_terms.قَضَى: He gave a binding legal judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the blood money for a hāshimah wound in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling on blood money for a specific type of injury. It reports that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام judged the compensation for a hāshimah, a wound involving fracture of the bone, to be ten camels.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5386 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni:
"Indeed, the Commander of the Faithful (as) ruled that for the hashimah (a wound that fractures the bone), the compensation is ten camels."
